_note: The capsule machine's upgrade tree (the machine tab's upgrades page): you're fixing up an old, broken machine. Every NODE grows 'from' another (it shows once that one is fixed), belongs to a 'branch' (repair = the trunk, coins, chutes, balls, shiny, lights, drops), sits at 'at' [x, y] on the tree's map (0..600 x 0..540, y down), and can be bought up to 'max' levels (1 for repairs). Each level costs 'coins' x 'grow' to the power of the levels you have, plus 'bits' (machine bits pets bring home from adventures: gear, spring, bolt, glass), the same every level. 'each' is what every level does: coins_x (every capsule's coins multiplied), chutes (+1 chute: a capsule each), double / triple (chance per chute of 2 / 3 balls), shiny (chance a ball is shiny), shiny_x (a shiny ball pays this much more than x2), lights (the lucky lights and fever work), fever_s (seconds more fever), drops (new kinds of balls: toys, boxes). 'says' is the pet's line about it, 'gain' the short line of what you get, 'fixes' what it mends on the machine's picture. GLOBES: a globe per map page (sunny, then sunset from beyond the fence, then midnight from next door). A globe other than the first comes home with its 'find' (a pet brings it from an adventure), broken; its nodes have 'globe' (default the first globe) and show once it's home. 'works' is the repair that makes it work: from then on it's the newest working globe and you pull it by hand, and your pet, workers and errands pay at the globe one step behind. 'hatch' is its rusted hatch: once fixed, box and pet box prizes on that globe are its 'box' tier and its toy set (data/toys.json sets 'globe') joins the toy roll (until then a globe drops what the one before it drops). 'step' multiplies its coin value. Effects count on their own globe AND every newer one (coins_x, double, triple, shiny, shiny_x, fever_s, drops), except chutes, lights and glass, which only count on their own globe (glass: shiny balls work on this globe). 'glass', 'body', 'seam', 'color' are its colours (a colour role like lilac, or #hex), 'arrives' what your pet says when it comes home, 'view' the tree map rect [x, y, w, h] its page frames. BITS: every machine bit, its name, plural, colour and the globe it belongs to (the bits pills show the newest globe's). Numbers are placeholders until tools/machine_pace.gd tunes them.
